subject: Communication Systems
questionText:
If the modulation index of an AM wave is changed
from 0 to 1, then the transmitted power is increased
by_______%.
Common Data: 16 and 17 
An AM modulator operates with the message signal, 
m(t)  = 9 cos 2t + 7 cos 60t
explanation: Practice Question from Communication Systems DPP-01 (Analog Communication AM & FM).
